metadata.description: palaia's own skill packages, loadable as one Claude Code plugin. The hub's marketplace (the dashboard's Marketplace page and the curated index) distributes add-ons; this manifest is the plugin-marketplace shape for these skills.

plugins.name: palaia-memory
plugins.description: Makes an agent use palaia's shared memory without being told, and work alongside other agent sessions: when to recall, how to resume work, what deserves capturing, and when to register, check in and reply.
